name: jit-orchestration-governor
description: Bounded JIT refresh, advisory orchestration guard, and completion feedback

interface.shortDescription: Refresh JIT context and check bounded orchestration contracts.
interface.longDescription: Refreshes bounded JIT context on startup, resume, clear, and compaction; evaluates complete PreToolUse orchestration metadata; and gives every subagent type at most one stateless completion-contract feedback pass. It records private diagnostics without becoming a workflow engine or project dependency.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check this material action against JIT orchestration requirements.
